newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Leader in China copper venture.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Leader in China copper venture.

text.p: Malaysian cable maker Leader Universal Holdings Bhd said on Monday it has agreed to participate in a joint venture to manufacture copper tubes in China.
Leader will hold a 55 percent stake in the joint venture while its Chinese partner, Shanghai Non-Ferrous Metals General Company will hold 45 percent, it said in a statement.
Leader said investment in the joint venture to produce 8,000 tonnes of copper tubes annually is estimated at $30 million.
Currently, most of China's copper tubes are imported, the statement said.
